If you're considering engineered wood flooring, this short guide explains the key benefits, installation considerations and what to expect before making your purchase.

What it is

Engineered wood flooring has a genuine hardwood top layer bonded over a multi-ply timber core. You get the authentic look and feel of solid wood with far greater stability underfoot.

Why homeowners choose it

It resists the expansion and contraction that affects solid wood, making it ideal for modern homes — beautiful, hard-wearing and built to last for decades.

Underfloor heating compatible

The layered construction copes well with gentle heat changes, so most of our engineered floors are suitable for use over underfloor heating. Always follow the recommended surface-temperature guidance.

Installation

Can be floated over underlay, glued or secret-nailed. Let the boards acclimatise in the room for around 48 hours before fitting for the best result.

Maintenance & care

Sweep or vacuum regularly and clean with a barely-damp mop and a dedicated wood-floor cleaner. A real-wood wear layer can often be lightly sanded and refreshed over time.

Engineered wood flooring has a genuine hardwood top layer bonded over a multi-ply timber core. You get the authentic look and feel of solid wood with far greater stability underfoot.

Why homeowners choose it

It resists the expansion and contraction that affects solid wood, making it ideal for modern homes — beautiful, hard-wearing and built to last for decades.

Underfloor heating compatible

The layered construction copes well with gentle heat changes, so most of our engineered floors are suitable for use over underfloor heating. Always follow the recommended surface-temperature guidance.

Installation

Can be floated over underlay, glued or secret-nailed. Let the boards acclimatise in the room for around 48 hours before fitting for the best result.

Maintenance & care

Sweep or vacuum regularly and clean with a barely-damp mop and a dedicated wood-floor cleaner. A real-wood wear layer can often be lightly sanded and refreshed over time.

Engineered Wood Flooring Guide

Learn More About Engineered Wood Flooring

If you're considering engineered wood flooring, this short guide explains the key benefits, installation considerations and what to expect before making your purchase.

Video provided by a third-party source and hosted on YouTube for educational purposes.

What it is

Engineered wood flooring has a genuine hardwood top layer bonded over a multi-ply timber core. You get the authentic look and feel of solid wood with far greater stability underfoot.

Why homeowners choose it

It resists the expansion and contraction that affects solid wood, making it ideal for modern homes — beautiful, hard-wearing and built to last for decades.

Underfloor heating compatible

The layered construction copes well with gentle heat changes, so most of our engineered floors are suitable for use over underfloor heating. Always follow the recommended surface-temperature guidance.

Installation

Can be floated over underlay, glued or secret-nailed. Let the boards acclimatise in the room for around 48 hours before fitting for the best result.

Maintenance & care

Sweep or vacuum regularly and clean with a barely-damp mop and a dedicated wood-floor cleaner. A real-wood wear layer can often be lightly sanded and refreshed over time.
